Photoreal cinematic live-action, 1881 London, 35 mm film grain, natural weight and pace.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:04. The camera holds a static shot as <Subject 2> drinks from the raised glass and sets it down on the counter, from 00:00 to 00:01. At 00:01 <Subject 1> picks up his own glass from the counter and drinks. At 00:03 <Subject 2>'s head turns to look <Subject 1> up and down, from his face to his stick and back, over the whole shot, and the turn continues to the last frame of the shot. The camera is close in at the quieter end of the counter, on the drinkers' side. The camera holds a static shot as <Subject 2> lifts the glass from the counter to his lips and drinks, from 00:04 to 00:06. At 00:06 his head turns away from <Subject 1> toward the doors and back to him, and the turn continues to the last frame of the shot. Behind them one drinker leaning on the brass rail with both elbows under a gasolier burning steady, from 00:04 to 00:09. <Subject 1>'s mouth is closed from 00:04 to 00:06 while his head turns away from <Subject 1> toward the doors.
